zh.chartTitle: 某创业公司融资稿：「营收连续四季度稳健增长」——附季度图（单位：万元）。但细看年报，年终其实还有一笔数据没被画进图里。

textRefs.debunk_axis2: Y 轴起点被抬到 1000 万——Q1 到 Q3 那点爬坡被视觉放大了好几倍！真实起点是 0，前三季度其实只是缓慢上行。
textRefs.debunk_quarter: Q4 这根柱（480 万）被压在图表最底下——如果把它算进全年，所谓「稳健增长」其实是「年底大跌」。图里缺的这根，才是真相。

manual: 纵轴起点诚实吗？小增长被放大了几次？
图里画的是「全部」季度吗，还是漏了某个？
hints: 纵轴从 1000 万起，「增长」被夸大了
有没有哪根柱子被故意矮化或没画出来？
zh.explanation: 这张营收图动了两个手脚：①Y 轴从 1000 万起，把前三季度的小幅爬坡放大成「稳健增长」；②把暴跌的 Q4 压在最底下、还不画进对比，让读者忽略全年其实是下跌的。看营收图先问：轴从哪里开始？柱子是全的吗？

en.chartTitle: A startup's funding pitch: 'revenue grew steadily four quarters straight' — with a quarterly chart (unit: 10k CNY). But the annual report quietly hides one year-end data point not drawn in.

textRefs.debunk_axis2: The Y axis starts at 10 million — the Q1-to-Q3 crawl is visually amplified several times! The honest baseline is 0; the first three quarters were just a slow uptick.
textRefs.debunk_quarter: The Q4 bar (4.8 million) is squashed at the chart's bottom — count it into the year and the 'steady growth' is really a 'year-end plunge'. The missing bar is the truth.

manual: Is the Y axis baseline honest? How many times was a small rise magnified?
Does the chart show ALL the quarters, or did one get left out?
hints: Y axis starts at 10M — 'growth' is exaggerated
Is any bar deliberately shrunk or left out?
en.explanation: This revenue chart cheats twice: ① the Y axis starts at 10 million, blowing the first three quarters' small climb into 'steady growth'; ② the plunging Q4 is squashed at the bottom and kept out of the comparison, so readers miss that the year is actually down. With revenue charts, ask: where does the axis start? are all the bars there?
